projections.candidate_blind_dependency_rule: [contract=customer-agent/dependency-basis@2 sha256=1cd161fbf6871aa3a9e1782b9d695427e6e9a9b04fa063e4a34311fcaf1c327f] dependency basis evidence may identify only these relation kinds: result-condition, result-reference, result-value-input. The basis itself must be relation-only. A basis must not equal a requested-output evidence span. A basis must not wrap a requested-output evidence span with action/control wording. A strictly smaller relation-only literal basis nested inside a broader requested-output evidence span is admissible; use the smallest such literal basis. When no valid relation-only basis exists under these rules, return relation=independent.
